export_rights.summary: BILL's Data Processing Addendum states that on termination or expiry of the agreement the customer has thirty (30) calendar days to request a download of their transaction history by contacting BILL Customer Support; after that window BILL deletes or de-identifies Personal Data except ordinary-course backups and legally required retention.
export_rights.post_termination_window: 30 calendar days to request a transaction-history download via BILL Customer Support (per DPA)

routes.how: Web app: Settings > Import & export. Select the entity and Export All (default filters) or Export with filters; the finished file appears in the export list for download. Settings > Import & export > Custom File Integration lists the complete set of exportable entities and lets you schedule recurring exports (e.g. weekly).
requires: user role with 'Sync with Accounting System' permission
permission to manage each record/transaction type being exported
gotchas: Exports are per-entity CSV files, not a single whole-account archive
Docs do not state that document attachments are included in these CSV exports

routes.how: GET /v3/exports lists exported record files produced by the exports configured/scheduled under Settings > Import & export > Custom File Integration; GET /v3/exports/{exportId}/download-link returns the download URL for a file. Endpoints announced 2026-05-12 on the BILL API changelog. Same session auth as the v3 API.
requires: API sign-in credentials for the organization
routes.rate_limits: Shares the v3 API limits: 20,000 requests per developer key per hour (error BDC_1144 when exceeded)
gotchas: Downloads only files produced by the export configuration in the web app; entities not enabled there will not appear

routes.how: BILL v3 REST API at developer.bill.com. Auth: POST /v3/login with username, password, organizationId, and devKey returns a sessionId used on all subsequent calls; sessions expire after 35 minutes of inactivity (48 hours idle for sync tokens). Standard REST GET endpoints per entity; GET list-of-documents responses include a downloadLink per document; GET /v3/reports/audit-trail/vendor/{vendorId} returns vendor change history. An OpenAPI/Markdown index is published at developer.bill.com/llms.txt.
routes.rate_limits: 20,000 requests per developer key per hour (BDC_1144 on breach); POST /v3/login limited to 200 per developer key per hour; concurrency limit of 3 requests per developer key per organization; SMS-sending endpoints limited to 5/minute
gotchas: Session-based auth (login endpoint), not simple static bearer tokens for the AP/AR API
Login rate limit (200/hour/devKey) constrains naive per-request re-login patterns

routes.how: Per-page grid exports in the web UI: e.g. on the Bills page or Payments Out page, or on a vendor's Bills/Payments tabs or a customer's Invoices/Payments tabs, select the download icon and choose 'Export .CSV' or 'Export to Excel'. Column headers to include/exclude are selectable before export; file lands in the browser Downloads as 'export'/'export-X'.
requires: permissions to view/manage the record type on the page
gotchas: Exports reflect the current page's filters and selected columns, so an unfiltered pass is needed for completeness

routes.how: BILL Help Center documents an 'Export reports' area and (for the American Express Vendor Pay edition) 'Export Profiles' — customizable export reports whose output downloads as spreadsheet files.
gotchas: Detailed report-builder capabilities were only partially visible in consulted docs; verify field coverage in-tenant

routes.how: BILL Spend & Expense (formerly Divvy) web app: filter the transactions view, choose displayed columns, and export the filtered data. Programmatic access via the Spend & Expense API (e.g. /v3/spend/transactions) using an S&E apiToken header.
requires: Spend & Expense web access (export not available in mobile app)
S&E API token for API access
routes.rate_limits: Spend & Expense API: 60 calls per token per minute
gotchas: Transaction export is not available from the mobile app

routes.how: Records request: an account Administrator requests a backup copy of processed bill documents and cashed-check images, delivered as a digital download via Box or on DVD. Documented cost $50 per BILL account per copy (Box digital download reduced to $25 'for a limited time'); orders typically process within 14 business days.
requires: paid records-request fee billed to the account
gotchas: Paid, vendor-fulfilled process with ~14 business day turnaround — not self-service
Documented contents are bill documents and cashed-check images; structured data is not stated to be included

routes.how: Audit trails are viewable in the web UI (Settings > Company Profile > Company Information > Audit Trail, or per-object via Details > Audit Trail) showing who made each create/edit and when, including sync/API/system actors. Programmatically, GET /v3/reports/audit-trail/vendor/{vendorId} returns per-vendor change records.
requires: BILL developer key and API session for the API route
gotchas: No whole-account audit-log bulk export was found in consulted docs — the documented API audit-trail endpoint is per-vendor
Audit-trail retention period is not documented

preservation_notes.attachments: Per-document downloadLink values via the v3 API document-list endpoints (upload limit 25MB/file suggests scale of stored files); the only documented bulk route is the paid Administrator records request delivering bill documents and cashed-check images via Box or DVD (~14 business days, $50/account, Box promo $25).
preservation_notes.audit_log: Viewable in UI (Settings > Company Profile > Audit Trail and per-object Audit Trail); API exposes GET /v3/reports/audit-trail/vendor/{vendorId}. No documented whole-account audit export and no documented retention period — verify in-tenant.

notes: Research constraint: all *.bill.com domains (help.bill.com, developer.bill.com, vendorpayhelp.bill.com, www.bill.com) were blocked by the research environment's egress proxy, so vendor pages could not be fetched directly; every claim here comes from vendor-doc excerpts surfaced through web search of those official pages. Treat nav paths and numbers as needing in-tenant confirmation. Honest unknowns: no whole-account one-click backup/export exists in the docs consulted (closest are per-entity CSV exports plus the paid Box/DVD document records request); no export of configuration artifacts (approval policies, custom fields, user roles, workflows) as restorable files was found; audit-trail retention and any UI audit export are undocumented; Spend & Expense statements are separately downloadable per the help center but details were not confirmed. The schema requires date-formatted 'retrieved'/'last_reviewed' values, so the tasking's literal 'undefined' placeholder was replaced with the research date 2026-08-08.
